# match() flow additions over machine_polluted.txt: clear the interface-name
# pin, then serialized candidate probing with release between attempts.
$ nmcli connection modify uuid 11111111-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-111111111111 connection.interface-name ""
$ nmcli -w 15 connection up uuid 11111111-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-111111111111 ifname enp36s0f0
Connection successfully activated
$ nmcli -w 10 connection down uuid 11111111-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-111111111111
Connection successfully deactivated
$ nmcli -w 15 connection up uuid 11111111-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-111111111111 ifname enp36s0f1
Connection successfully activated
